1. Wi-Fi connection is required for wireless debugging.
2. Open Developer Options and enable \"Wireless debugging\".
3. Tap \"Pair device with pairing code\" and enter the 6-digit code via the notification\'s [Enter Code] without leaving the Settings screen (first time only).
4. Wireless debugging must be re-enabled after device reboot or switching Wi-Fi networks.
※ If \"Wireless debugging\" is grayed out and disabled, temporarily turn OFF \"Auto Blocker\" in Security settings.

When you open \"Pair device with pairing code\" in Developer Options, a notification appears automatically. Tap \"Enter Code\" directly on the notification to submit the 6-digit code while keeping the pairing screen open.

Typical pattern for malware: allows monitoring and auto-clicking on UI and displaying phishing overlay screens.
Bulk Auto-Grant Risk: Sensitive Permissions on Legacy SDK
Because targetSdkVersion is 22 or lower, sensitive permissions (SMS, location, contacts, etc.) are automatically granted at install time without runtime consent.
